name: URTC-VISION-TOOL
build: bash build_firmware.sh. Also contains an independent Python vision companion package (cd src/vision_companion && pip install -e '.[dev]' && pytest).
notes: Firmware has a hardware-independent sensor protocol (versioned framing with CRC8, range validation, minimum-interval throttling, replay and stale-sensor detection, error and latency counters kept apart from any accept or reject decision), with a host-side sensor simulator covering valid, truncated, CRC-corrupt, out-of-range and disconnected frames - 190 host-native test assertions. It is also run through a virtual sensor link with injected faults, and has never been run on a board or with a real sensor. The Python vision_companion package is test-covered: synthetic thermal and RGB frames, false-colour rendering, and RGB-to-thermal ROI alignment with temperature statistics, and a thermal calibration (gain, offsets, dead pixels) loaded from a JSON file, verified by 183 real pytest cases. Wiring a real MLX9064x/RGB sensor over I2C/SPI, real dual-modal capture and per-pixel calibration still need a real PCB and real cameras.
